general.subtitulo: Cessation, case closure and changes to dates or working hours
general.ayuda: A cessation is recorded with a reason from the catalogue, its effective date and the supporting document (its reference and the file, of which only the digital fingerprint is recorded). Once it has been recorded, the recruitment pool receives the contract end date so that the person can be reinstated. Closure requires the cessation and, where required by the catalogue, the confirmed GINPIX record and its number. When GINPIX returns the record registration number, record it here once using ‘Confirm GINPIX record’; closure uses that number and does not allow a different one, and closure is unavailable until it has been confirmed. The centre confirms that the person has taken up the post from its requests, using the assumption-of-duty document or signed contract specified by the catalogue; the date and document type are shown here. If the person who accepted does not take up the post, record the reason from the catalogue and the decision (its reference and the file, of which only the digital fingerprint is recorded). If the catalogue requires a second person, the person who identifies this proposes it using ‘Propose failure to take up post’, and it has no effect yet; another HR officer, who must be different from the proposer and use their own session, sees the proposal in this panel and confirms or rejects it. Only when it is confirmed (or recorded in a single step, if the catalogue does not require a second person, stating who decided it) does the case return to financial scrutiny, the recruitment pool applies the removal specified by its catalogue and the call-up continues with the next person from the call-up panel. If rejected, the proposal is closed without effect and another may be submitted. When the next person accepts, their appointment proposal becomes the current one and the previous proposal remains in the history as superseded because the person did not take up the post, with the reason and date; all subsequent monitoring (taking up post, GINPIX, cessation and closure) then relates to the new person. A change to dates or working hours creates a new version of the analysis, recalculates the cost and returns the case to the stage specified by the catalogue.
